shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Reading the wrong type
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in optional and variant?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in optional and variant? Bug of the Day. The variant holds an int, but we read a string. The program stops with a bad variant access error. Check the type first with holds alternative. Get throws an exception when the variant holds another type. Check with holds alternative first, or use visit. Optional holds a value or nothing.
